panel.tokenization: exact Unicode whitespace split; case, punctuation, marker retained
panel.record_order: first appearance in original table; lines original table order
panel.written: whole held-book records in order; stop before first overflow
panel.reference: round-robin other books in SPEC order; whole records in each original order; stop before first overflow; skip exhausted book only
panel.vocabulary_tie: descending count then exact Unicode string; independently permute selected IDs afterward
panel.opaque_seed_rule: base + 2*fold_index + side_index, written=0 reference=1; NumPy default_rng permutation

capacity.failure: NO_CAPACITY without smaller vocabulary or threshold repair

geometry.ppmi: max(0, log(C_ij * sum_all_C / (row_i_sum * col_j_sum))); zero count=zero; marginals over ALL center types before selected rows
geometry.context_columns: own top1024 types plus RARE, separately tagged by each of10 offsets
geometry.distance: 1-cosine, clipped[0,2], diagonal0, divide by ordered offdiagonal mean

transport.p: selected written counts normalized to sum1
transport.q: selected reference counts normalized to sum1
transport.B_cost: squared Euclidean distance between16 within-space offdiagonal row quantiles
transport.baseline_cost_scaling: divide pair cost by full-cell mean; zero mean stays zero
transport.baseline_objective: sum(cost*G) plus identical column and joint KL terms

optimizer.initial_Z: log(q)+Normal(0,.1) from NumPy default_rng(seed), full n-by-m array
optimizer.selection: minimum declared objective AFTER step200; exact ties seed order
optimizer.ranking: descending normalized row coupling; exact ties opaque candidate index
optimizer.failure: INVALID_NUMERICS; no repaired optimizer or skipped fold/world

nulls.operation: independently globally permute all tokens within each side panel; reinsert original record lengths
nulls.refit: full geometry and all3 starts of B/G; F identical input/output reused with hash
nulls.vocabulary_and_ids: same frequency-selected types and IDs; count-preserving worlds

scoring.eligibility: blinded surface_span_marked equals complete containing whitespace group, exactly one marker; selected raw node; no expansion-based selection
scoring.truth: exact expanded_span; OOV, empty or multiword spans are errors, no normalization
scoring.primary: mean over selected observable marked types of occurrence top5 inclusion; then equal mean4books
secondary: all eligible marked coverage including unsupported types
scoring.gold_release: after ALL4observed folds and ALL19worlds complete, rankings/fit code/payloads locked

promotion.null_rank: (1+number of19 null aggregate G-minus-max(F,B) gains >= observed aggregate gain)/20
promotion.interpretation: operational conditional source ranking criterion, not population/project-wide significance or target meaning probability

claim_ceiling: Source-only editorial-representation word-candidate recovery. No Voynich writer/language, translation, calibrated target confidence or independent semantic confirmation.
